theorems.name: Submission.dsmc_chart_inverse_continuity
theorems.statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (V : Set (Euclid d)) (W : Set (Euclid P)) (ψ : Euclid d → Euclid P), ContinuousOn ψ V → InjOn ψ V → ψ '' V ⊆ W → (∀ K ⊆ W, IsCompact K → IsCompact (V ∩ ψ ⁻¹' K)) → ∀ v ∈ V, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ v' ∈ V, dist (ψ v') (ψ v) < δ → dist v' v < ε
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
